751-3755-6633.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

770-2226-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
770-2226-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying its mana cost.
When Man-o'-War enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

6-2416-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
6-2416-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-2416-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Rise and Shine.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

512-527-1719.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
512-527-1719.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
512-527-1719.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-527-1719.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4314-4474--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4314-4474--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3318-3534.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-3318-3534.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3318-3534.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1329-1778-2178-6495.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-6495.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1329-1778-2178-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

789-2438-2738-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Gutter Grime, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

206-3259-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2511-2946-4556-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2511-2946-4556-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

608-725-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R} and goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Xyris's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the Snake, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

5147-5571-7666--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

661-3685-4659-5060.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
661-3685-4659-5060.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying at most {2} due to Cemetery Prowler. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1806-1887-2060-2438-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vorinclex.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2292-3497-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
2292-3497-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

803-3000-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog by paying {G}{U}
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Arcane Adaptation, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
Repeat step 3.
803-3000-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1753-3899-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

1850-5413-5967.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-5413-5967.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1766-1987-4311-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Thran Dynamo by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Thran Dynamo.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a Spider you control without summoning sickness
attached to the Spider that has Thornbite Staff attached

940-1729-2178.description:
Activate the Spider with Thornbite Staff and Arcane Teachings attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls and destroying it due to the Spider's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shelob and the Spider tapped in step 1 trigger.
Resolve the Shelob trigger, creating a token copy of the creature that died that is a Food artifact.
Resolve the Spider trigger, untapping it.
Repeat as desired. You can also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

3327-4381-4613-5073.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
3327-4381-4613-5073.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

777-1525-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

1445-2034-2279-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2034-2279-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token. 
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1251-4053-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1251-4053-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

575-1207-2511.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1486-1651-5334.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Roaming Throne and another artifact, targeting Roaming Throne.
Magda triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Roaming Throne.
Repeat.

779-4030-4970-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1020-2034-5751--49.description:
Cast Myr Retriever from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {2} and discarding the artifact land card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning the artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

575-2292-5624.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nervous Gardener.
When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nervous Gardener's disguise ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Nervous Gardener triggers, causing you to search your library for a land with a basic land type and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

413-4871-5544.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting any opponent.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers when Forsaken Miner dies, and Forsaken Miner triggers when you commit the crime in step 1.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Forsaken Miner trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat.

1940-2292-4191-5010.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Liliana trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

2226-2397-3977.manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2226-2397-3977.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2397-3977.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Horned Kavu by paying {R}{G}.
When Horned Kavu enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's other abilities.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Horned Kavu by paying its mana cost.
When Horned Kavu enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

819-1456-1980-5195.description:
Cast any spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Memory Lapse either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Swarm Intelligence and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying Memory Lapse, targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
